name: 1 Thessalonians
kanji: テサロニケ人への第一の手紙
lede: The fifty-second book of the Bible, in full: Paul's first letter to the church of the Thessalonians, written at Corinth with Silvanus and Timothy soon after he was driven from Thessalonica — ye turned unto God from idols, gentle as a nurse, working night and day, as a father with his own children, Timothy sent and his good tidings, study to be quiet and to work with your hands, them that fall asleep, the shout, the voice of the archangel and the trump of God, caught up in the clouds, the day of the Lord as a thief in the night, sons of light, the breastplate of faith and love and the helmet of hope, rejoice always, pray without ceasing, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: Turned unto God from Idols
books.blurb: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, unto the church of the Thessalonians — the letter written at Corinth; your work of faith and labor of love and patience of hope; from you hath sounded forth the word of the Lord; ye turned unto God from idols, to wait for his Son from heaven; shamefully treated at Philippi; gentle as a nurse with her own children; working night and day; as a father with his own children; Satan hindered us; ye are our glory and our joy; left behind at Athens alone, we sent Timothy; and Timothy came even now unto us with glad tidings; now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.

books.name: The Trump of God
books.blurb: How ye ought to walk and to please God; this is the will of God, even your sanctification; study to be quiet, and to work with your hands; concerning them that fall asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as the rest, who have no hope; the Lord himself shall descend from heaven, with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God, and we shall be caught up in the clouds; the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night; ye are all sons of light; the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation; rejoice always, pray without ceasing, in everything give thanks; salute all the brethren with a holy kiss.
